snippet.title: HideAndLuig web game
snippet.description:
play here: https://html5.gamedistribution.com/da50a8ab728c4b31bfed0d28f204466e/

Hide and Luig is a whimsical point-and-click hide-and-seek adventure where your only goal is to find the ever-elusive Luig—who insists on hiding inside the weirdest objects imaginable.
Explore playful scenes, click around, and uncover Luig’s latest hideout in this charmingly absurd journey of curiosity and surprise.
